blurb: Guests experience hot air balloon rides over Pennsylvania countryside with flights occurring twice daily near sunrise and sunset. Flights include inflation, flight, champagne toast, and return, lasting about 2.5 to 3 hours total. Safety is emphasized with a 100% safety record since 1982 and flights depend on favorable weather conditions.
